task.problem_statement: Quantum neural-network classifiers need cross-entropy training with probability-valued outputs. The loss and its gradients must support binary and multiple-output classification and integrate with the existing quantum model fitting workflow.
requirements: Provide binary and multiple-output cross-entropy values with numerical clipping.
Compute parameter gradients from the supplied model-output derivatives.
Support training and prediction of quantum neural-network classifiers with cross-entropy loss for both single and multiple observables.
Preserve the neighboring quantum neural-network regression workflow.

interface.Name: CrossEntropyLoss.value
interface.Description: Computes loss from value_dict["f"] and ground_truth.

interface.Name: CrossEntropyLoss.gradient
interface.Description: Computes parameter gradients; accepts ground_truth and multiple_output.

interface.Name: CrossEntropyLoss.set_opt_param_op
interface.Description: Selects whether observable parameters are optimized.

interface.Name: QNNClassifier.fit
interface.Description: Fits a cross-entropy classifier and updates circuit and observable parameters.

interface.Name: QNNClassifier.predict
interface.Description: Returns class predictions with the same target shape.
